definition: Capacitively coupled plasma; use only when the source identifies CCP.

label: ICP etching
definition: Inductively coupled plasma; use only when the source identifies ICP.

label: pvd
definition: As defined by source passage; no inferred conversion or partition.

label: furnace
definition: As defined by source passage; no inferred conversion or partition.

label: Thin-film deposition equipment
definition: All source-reported thin-film deposition equipment categories; not PVD-only or TSV-only.

label: Kingsemi FY2024 equipment quantity table
definition: Source-native FY2024 production and sales table; product rows retain their own category labels.

label: LPCVD thin-film deposition equipment
definition: Issuer-reported scope where LPCVD is named specifically, as distinct from a broader 薄膜设备 thin-film basket. Follows the shared bare-category scope convention used for etch_ccp, etch_icp and deposition.

label: All thinning equipment
definition: All thinning equipment (parallel to the existing shared 'cmp' scope for CMP); used where a source states a thinning-family figure (e.g. backlog, capacity) without naming or resolving to a specific model or thinning sub-category.

label: All implant equipment
definition: All ion-implantation equipment (parallel to the existing shared 'cmp' scope for CMP); used where a source states an implant-family figure without naming or resolving to a specific model or beam-current/energy class.
